source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/entrainment_gated_ft

echo "=== exp-004 START: $(date) ==="

echo "--- GatedDeltaNet ---"
python -u analysis/extract_attention_weights.py --arch gdn --device cuda:0
echo "--- GDN DONE: $(date) ---"

echo "--- RetNet ---"
python -u analysis/extract_attention_weights.py --arch retnet --device cuda:0
echo "--- RetNet DONE: $(date) ---"

echo "--- HGRN2 ---"
python -u analysis/extract_attention_weights.py --arch hgrn2 --device cuda:0
echo "--- HGRN2 DONE: $(date) ---"

echo "--- Analysis ---"
python -u analysis/extract_attention_weights.py --analyze
echo "--- Analysis DONE: $(date) ---"

echo "=== exp-004 ALL DONE: $(date) ==="
RUNSCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/analysis/run_exp004.sh && echo "SCRIPT_CREATED"
